# CRM Integration Specialists

> CRM Integration Specialists, led by Ammar Hussain, builds custom bi-directional integrations between CRM and marketing automation platforms (GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, and legal-specific CRMs like Clio, Lawmatics, Filevine, CasePeer), custom API and webhook middleware, AI voice agent deployments (Retell AI, Twilio), and multi-step workflow automation (n8n, Make). Clients are mid-market B2B companies, marketing agencies, service enterprises, and fast-scaling SaaS businesses that need real-time lead routing, scheduling, and customer data sync between systems that don't talk to each other natively.

Every integration is built on webhook-driven, real-time sync rather than scheduled batch polling, with field-level mapping, conflict resolution, signature verification, and retry-safe queuing built into the middleware layer. Typical round-trip sync latency is under one second.

## Core Services

- [Bi-Directional CRM Integration](https://www.crmintegrationspecialist.com/services/crm-integration/): Real-time, two-way sync between GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, and industry-specific CRMs.
- [Custom API & Webhook Middleware](https://www.crmintegrationspecialist.com/services/webhook-middleware/): Purpose-built middleware for validating, transforming, and routing webhook events, including signature verification and dead-letter handling.
- [AI Voice Agent Deployment](https://www.crmintegrationspecialist.com/services/ai-voice-agents/): Retell AI and Twilio voice agents wired directly into CRM systems for live call logging and case/deal updates.
- [Workflow & Pipeline Automation](https://www.crmintegrationspecialist.com/services/automation/): Multi-step automation pipelines built on n8n and Make connecting intake, CRM, billing, and voice systems.
